answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: (a) a trail line is recognisable by marker: the census regex (fold, MEASURED, SETTLES, re-point, superseded) found 165 such lines on 62 of the 276 open tickets, measured 2026-11-14. A line that is trail and wears no marker stays in the plan, and the run's report names that ticket's remaining lacks, so it is seen and not hidden. (b) PROVED is read from workflow_and_state carrying [PROVED]: 771 measured. (c) Q#96 (outline 9.3.5.1.1) settles that `by` is neither checked nor kept, so dropping it onto the log loses nothing and retire's author tooth goes with it.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: which markers count as trail (the list above, case-folded, at the head of a decision's text); where the log door is (cairn/tools/base/ticket_log.py append_log, kind decision_retired); that the plan is rewritten through the artifact door (rehearsal._write_ticket), never write_text; how to tell PROVED ([PROVED] in workflow_and_state of the state file, else the plan); how to parse a prose falsifier: split on '(n)' or 'n.' numbering, refusing to guess when the numbers do not run 1..k; and that the run targets a root argument so the proof aims it at a scratch commons. All carried in the decisions.
answers.children: none, because d421051bc1f7's remainder is rebuilt by hand as this ticket's first worked example, and the schema (9447) and renderer (38d1) are their own cast tickets
answers.collision_check: Real collision with retire's author tooth (rehearsal._retire_lacks: 'not yours to retire') against outline 9.3.5.1.1 (Q#96: `by` is not checked and not kept). The why of the tooth was that a line is its author's to withdraw; the why of Q#96 is that authorship is not tracked (LLM or code is the only writer question). Q#96 is the later, answered decision, so the tooth goes. Not a collision with 0.2.1: its by-lines are on outline answers and readings, not ticket decision lines. Not a collision with Law 5: the log is the history beside the plan, so moving trail there is that Law's own direction.
answers.falsifier_check: Five clauses, horizon this ticket's PROVEME: (1) after the run every open ticket passes transitions._shape_lacks or is named in the report with its lacks; (2) no open plan carries a fold, MEASURED, SETTLES or re-point line, and no decision carries `by`; (3) every moved line stands verbatim in its ticket's log as decision_retired, and every dropped `by` stands in the log; (4) every PROVED ticket's three files are byte-identical before and after; (5) a second run moves nothing and writes nothing. All five measured over a scratch copy of the commons, never the live store.
answers.gates_bound: code-seam's set: BUILDME entry (chart claim, intent and sorted berths, outline check, every answer), PROVEME (its proof green and hollow-sealed: red with the migration module blocked), PROVED reads cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json; a failure feeds back to this ticket through FIXME.
answers.missing_check: Big-decision prose (a line that is design, not a build step) is moved to the log like any trail line, and the report names its ticket so the owning intention can take the prose; the migration does not write intentions itself. A prose falsifier with no numbered clauses cannot be parsed and stays a named lack in the report. The migration does not invent bounds or measured; their absence stays a named lack. d421 is rebuilt first, by hand, as the worked example.
